title: WWF WrestleMania: The Arcade Game
overview:
Take WWF wrestling to the extreme with intense action straight from the arcade smash! It's in-your-face mayhem with punishing head-to-head and team match ups. No pain, no game!

Step into the ring as one of eight digitized WWF superstars: Doink, Razor Ramon, Yokozuna, Lex Luger, Shawn Michaels, Bret "Hit Man" Hart, The Undertaker and Bam Bam Bigelow. Matches play like a fighting game, mixing punches, kicks, slams, reversals and turnbuckle dives with outrageous signature moves, and you need two pins to win.

- Fight for the Intercontinental and WWF Championships against handicap odds of up to 3-on-1
- Battle head to head with a friend, or team up to win the tag team title
- Fill the combo meter to unleash punishing combos
- Commentary from Vince McMahon and Jerry Lawler
